request.title: Port P0247: 37 ready modules to Lean 4.36 (3 fixed, 34 unchanged)
request.body:
Refs #32694

Submits the 37 ready members of P0247 on Lean `leanprover/lean4:v4.36.0` (`Lean (version 4.36.0, x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, commit 611c117bfaf7b7ae1cfcf246ce6fba31e8f509e9, Release)`) and Mathlib `fc4f59e577feb1a4956671bc04ac18aaaf8cd842` (v4.36.0): 3 patched modules and 34 `unchanged` records. This is a partial submission under the completed-subset rules: the packet is still incomplete and the claim #32694 stays open.

Submitted IDs: `M043609`, `M043612`, `M043614`, `M043616`, `M043619`, `M043718`, `M043800`, `M043879`, `M044117`, `M044143`, `M044302`, `M044418`, `M044419`, `M044437`, `M044488`, `M044490`, `M044514`, `M044521`, `M044528`, `M044656`, `M044658`, `M044943`, `M045088`, `M045265`, `M045441`, `M045484`, `M045501`, `M045758`, `M045768`, `M046183`, `M046195`, `M046344`, `M046471`, `M046654`, `M047184`, `M047480`, `M047896`.

Remaining live modules and their missing imports:

- `M046414`: missing import `M037822`
- `M046803`: missing import `M046802`
- `M046864`: missing import `M056084`

Excluded pruned IDs: none.

### Fixes

- `M043800` (MonoPullbackMapOfFlat): Proof/definition-body only: TopCat.Sheaf is now an ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory whose underlying-object field is `obj` instead of `val`, so `X.ringCatSheaf.val` becomes `X.ringCatSheaf.obj` in the instance header at line 41 and in the type of skyPresheafOfModules at line 44. Both denote the same underlying presheaf of rings of X, so the instance and definition are unchanged in meaning. No other edits.
- `M044521` (NormIteratedFDerivProdCoordLeLeibniz): Proof-only: Finset.prod_le_one for nonnegative factors is now Finset.prod_le_one₀ (same arguments), and contDiff_apply now takes the codomain as a family, so `contDiff_apply ℝ ℂ i` becomes `contDiff_apply ℝ (fun _ : ι => ℂ) i` (the same projection w ↦ w i on ι → ℂ). Statements unchanged.
- `M045768` (PicardTorsionTrivialOfTorsorsHaveSections): Statement change in notation only: MultilinearMap is now semilinear and takes a ring homomorphism, so `MultilinearMap B (fun _ : Fin q => L) B` is written `MultilinearMap (RingHom.id B) (fun _ : Fin q => L) B` in p1, p2, p4 and free_of_section. With the identity homomorphism this is exactly the pinned B-multilinear map type, and it matches the already-ported statements of the imported GlobalTheory.T.exists_multilinear_form_of_pic_torsion (M027626), kummerAlgebra_finite_projective_faithfullyFlat (M039984) and kummerAlgebra_zmod_torsor_bijective (M039986), which these theorems restate. Proofs unchanged.

The other 34 members built unchanged; `check` reported no `REUSED_NAMES` mentions for them.

### Evidence

Commands run on this worker (4 vCPU, 16 GB, Linux x86_64):

- `python3 tracker/port_build.py check P0247 WORK --ready-only`: 34 of 37 built before the fixes (M043800, M044521, M045768 failed); each fixed module then rebuilt with `lake --no-cache build +<Module>:olean`, exit 0.
- `python3 tracker/port_build.py reproduce P0247 WORK OUT --issue 32694 --ready-only`: fresh tree from the verified archive plus import and packet patches, `lake --no-cache build` per module: **37 of 37 modules built**, every exit code 0 (13:08–13:28 UTC).
- `lake env lean --run port/islattice_audit.lean <37 modules>`: `islattice-audit: 37 module(s), 0 hit(s)`.
- `lake env lean --run port/reused_audit.lean <37 modules>`: `reused-audit: 37 module(s), 0 hit(s)`.
- `python3 tracker/validate_ports.py`: `Validated 15201 port records.`
- The patches add no `sorry`, `admit`, `axiom`, `implemented_by`, `native_decide` or `unsafe`. Nothing touches `Main`, `Statements` or the public theorems.
